verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a REST API that can reach any existing object in an account and returns standard JSON (JSON API spec) with a published OpenAPI 3.0 definition. Its MCP server also exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more, so a user could script their own extraction in an open format. The evidence never mentions a first-party bulk export, a one-click full-account download, export of documents and policies in open file formats, or any offboarding or data-deletion process for leaving. Missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export, open file-format exports (e.g. CSV/JSON/PDF) for policies and evidence, offboarding and data-portability guarantees, and independent corroboration that complete exports work.
